description: Background speaker talks over the candidate (2.5s-4.5s) and their words leak into the candidate's STT stream as 4 inserted words over an 8-word reference (WER 4/8 = 0.5). Diarization detects only one speaker, so all background speech is attributed to the candidate. This is the hypothesised freeze mechanism.
